reason: The thesis (NU-CS-2024-16) has no title page and names no advisor. It extends CatSAT, "a stochastic SAT solver written by Dr. Ian Horswill", runs code he wrote, and its acknowledgements thank him first for "mentorship he has given me over the past few years" and the "students in Dr. Horswill's research group" she worked with "over the past two years".
